text.card: A red giant 1,106 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.19 solar masses and 13.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,504 K at its surface.
